review_description: Fantastic company to deal with, we were kept up to date through the whole process, customer service is excellent. Installers were great to deal with. Very happy with our solar system.

Very happy with Huglo from start to finish. Lee was fantastic at explaining the system and process and answered all of my many questions. The installation team were efficient, polite and respectful, they also cleaned up beautifully at the end of the day.Daniel has been great in keeping us informed and checking in regularly. We did have to wait nearly 2 months for the battery but that was a supply issue and was out of Huglo's control.Overall a very smooth and pleasant experience.We would highly recommend Huglo.

Huglo is a terrific company they installed our solar panels and now a battery. Their service has always been professional and delivered quickly. I would recommend this company to anyone who wants solar.

A seamless installation by Dorji and crew. We had to make some adjustments mid-way to avoid asbestos sheeting but all was done quickly and effectively. The advice I obtained prior to installation allowed me to plan the size of the system and we now have a full battery and power to export. The final product fits neatly on roof and the wall below.

All stages and steps in this process (from first contact to sign off) were trouble free and easy.  I was expecting to be confused with technical detail and specialist speak.  Not so - all communications have been in my language and all people I have communicated with have taken special care to ensure that I fully understood answers to my questions.The design, planning, offers of various options, discussions about cost and comparisons and pros and cons of the 3 options discussed were very clear and Huglo people were very patient with me.The site visit and subsequent installation visits were enjoyable for me.The installation team was professional, efficient, arrived on time and worked constantly from start to finish.  There was no stopping for phone calls or conversations other than discussions of approach to the task and planning for and solving site problems.The team was well integrated, were familiar and friendly with each other and the Supervisor appeared to me to be the first amongst equals (ie not an officious controller) and, consequently it was a harmonious and happy team.At the end of the job all debris and materials were removed and the place needed no cleaning or tidying by me.I can not fault Huglo in any way and will promote them when I am asked by neighbours and friends about how the process went.The new installation is working really well.  I have compared the performance of the old 5.9kW system which has been replaced by the new 11.875kW system and the difference is amazing.  See photo below - please ignore the first one (mistake) and I cannot work out how to remove it..  The weather conditions on the day before the changeover and the full day following were essentially identical.I couldn't be happier (or more impressed!)

From the moment I first started a conversation with about my solar requirements with the Lee and the team at Huglo I knew I was dealing with a professional organization and not the usual run of the mill salesman. I had some more difficult requirements and it was clear these were not only understood but planned for correctly well in advance. My PM Chloe was excellent in keeping my informed about the process before and after the install. The installation team were excellent and did a really neat job with my work. To summarize I highly recommend Huglo solar for anyone serious about their energy independence.

I had a fantastic experience with Huglo and could not recommend them more highly. It has been several months since Huglo installed my AIKO Solar and Sigenergy battery/EV charger system and I have been very satisfied with the installation and after sales service.After first contacting Huglo, Lee came out to our house to do an initial look around and to learn more about what we wanted. He spent lots of time with us and provided lots of relevant information. He was a great listener, explained the differences between different options and was never pushy (far from it!). Our quote was provided electronically and it was easy to work with Lee on a couple of minor changes before accepting it.Lee also visited again for a final site inspection, then on install day everything went really well. There was one small issue with the installation which Lee and the team were happy to address promptly and at no cost to make sure we were satisfied.When the system required its first software update I had some trouble installing it. I contacted Huglo and they were able to help me out remotely. Again it was dealt with very promptly and professionally.

After two days battling Mother Nature’s winds, the legends at Huglo Energy pushed through and delivered an awesome install today.Big thanks to the team for the hard work—how good does this setup look!Running a Sungrow Inverter + Sungrow Battery paired with Aiko 475W Stealth Black Panels—clean, sleek, and ready to power on.

From the initial contact of getting the quote all the way through to job completion, the Huglo team conducted themselves in a totally professional manner. Nick and his team arrived on time and kept the work area clean and tidy, and kept us informed of their progress throughout the project. I would highly recommend this company to anybody thinking of fitting a solar system their house.
The team was very helpful and efficient.  Their followup was great.

Talking to them during the quotation phase gave me great confidence and I wasn't disappointed by the installation team, who were fantastic. A minor issue was resolved quickly and the system works great.

I've just had a REAPower 20kW battery installed by Huglo.  From initial contact, through planning, booking, answering my dumb questions and the install and follow up, Tim and the team have excelled.  They were helpful in getting a product that suited my needs and the tech guys who did the install were efficient, polite, and effective - I have a working system!  I received a follow up call and the offer of ongoing support with the app and in evaluating electricity providers.Couldn't be happier and I would unreservedly recommend Huglo.

Purchased a battery adding to a domestic three year old solar system.  Good information before contracting; flexible with installation arrangements. Responsive to my inquiries during and post installation.  Easy to deal with.

This was a company that made the whole process a pleasure.The communication and options plus answers to questions helped make it easy to decide this was who I wanted to supply and install my battery and backup system, plus upgrade my meterbox. I can now say without a doubt I was  right.The team were efficient tidy and friendly. I would have no reservations at all with recommending this company if you want a high standard of work done.
Lee took the time to explain things in detail. This company doesn't cut corners and everyone has been a delight to deal with, from the boss, to the reception to the installers.

From the very first phone call to the final handover, Huglo made going solar a breeze. We had several somewhat unusual requests and the team worked with us to find the best solutions.1) Tim, our consultant, walked us through panel and inverter options in plain language, explained the pros and cons of each, and never tried to upsell. He offered us several options, explained their differences, and updated quotes aligning with our requests promptly.2) They modelled our daytime loads and future plans and designed a system that maximises self-consumption  (as we wanted).3) The day of installation went brilliantly. The team arrived on time, kept the site clean, and completed the job quickly and efficiently. They gave a heads up when they needed to switch off our electricity and guided through the system after the installation.4) Grid connection, meter upgrade and feed-in tariff switch were all handled behind the scenes, so we didn’t need to chase any forms.Overall, we are very happy with our system. Huglo delivered exactly what they promised. We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone in Canberra or beyond looking for a reliable solar partner.

From the time of initial inspection and quotation through to the full installation and certification we cannot fault the quality, communication and professionalism of the Huglo Solar Team.  Everything was made so easy on our end.
From start to finish the installation of our solar panels went smoothly. I can't recommend Huglo Solar highly enough!

Huglo Solar were very quick to reply and return calls, and they kept to appointments (weather dependent). This made the process super lovely despite complications (our distribution box wasnt big enough and our house is on 2 phase).There was a bit of correcting details with them, which required me to understand what exactly was planned, but it didn't matter much because the right people were so easy to contact.They organised grid connection, they checked the generation was as they expected, and followed up bugs with the inverter (from being a 2-phase system) months after installation.My parents also got an install by Huglo Solar, and their experience was very similar.

We received great service from Huglo from quote through to install. The team turned up on time and did a great job on the installation of solar and battery. Cleaned up the job site too. Five stars all the way
The whole Huglo team was great from start to finish.

Quick, informative and consultative sales/quoting process.Huglo started off the process of getting a smart meter installed for me.Installation was started and completed on the scheduled day.System was feeding into the house, battery and grid by the end of the day.Huglo also integrated my 7 y/o 5kW system so I now have 11.8kW of panels feeding into my house and battery and the iSolarCloud app shows the total energy from all panels and two inverters.

I recently had a solar and battery system installed by Huglo Solar, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. From pre-sales to installation and after-sales service, every step was handled with exceptional professionalism and care.The team at Huglo Solar was incredibly flexible, scheduling my battery installation to coincide with the start of the NSW battery rebate scheme. This allowed me to upsize my battery without impacting my overall budget. Their attention to detail and customer-focused approach made the entire process smooth and stress-free.Part of the install was to enable the 'load control' features of the Sungrow inverter. This allows us to heat our hot water system during the day once the battery is fully recharged and as we are starting to export energy.  We had the system installed two months ago at the start of summer (so there's plenty of generation happening) and so far I have not had to purchase any electricity from the grid!I highly recommend Huglo Solar for anyone considering solar and battery installations in the region. Their dedication to customer satisfaction and quality service is truly commendable.

Two systems were involved (13.7kw).  The process for getting a quote was smooth and trouble free.  My questions were answered simply and fully.  They listened to my suggestions and reasons and agreed or suggested better.  They provided advice for future installation of a battery/s.Communications with project management team were clear, polite and prompt in response.Installation was also trouble free.  From the ground it looks great.  They also replaced broken roof tiles while they were up there.  The lead installer/electrician was punctual, polite and was knowledgable about the job prior to starting.  He also asked if I was happy with what was to happen and afterwards as well.  He also set up the WiFi connection. Work finished as the smart meter installer arrived.  Smooth as.Liaison with the electricity authority was taken care of by Huglo.  I had to change smart meter installation date as the that company would only talk with the owner.All was explained to me on the day of commissioning and I received all certificates and manuals promptly afterwards.My WiFi modem died coincidentally 2 days later and when the new modem arrived I received instructions from Huglo on how to connect and that ended up being successful and easy after a short phone call from them to assist.The systems have been in for just over a week.I am thoroughly happy and I recommend them.

From initial quote to post installation support, Huglo was fantastic. The team communicated clearly and regularly, providing plenty of honest options, advice and guidance. Their pricing was very competitive and the quality of their work was excellent. They even detected a minor comms fault remotely, informing me and coming to fix it quickly and simply. I highly recommend Huglo Solar for your installation.
Everyone from Huglo was a pleasure to work with. They were professional, punctual, and did excellent quality work. Will definitely be reaching out to them again for future jobs

Huglo Solar was a recommended solar installation company through SolarQuotes. From start to finish I have found Huglo Solar to provide exceptional service. Their initial site visit and explanation of the solar options available was great and enabled us to select a solar system and battery that would not only meet current needs but in future requirements. The installation team were great and did a fantastic job within the expected 2 days. I would  highly recommend the team from Huglo.

From the very start, Luke from Huglo was very helpful in explaining the options and proposed layout of the panels (10.56kw). A subsequent site visit identified limitations on the roof space and alternative was promptly suggested. Once installation commenced, Justin explained some final tweaks to the layout would be required, but that these relocated (4) panels would also capture more light from the morning sun. Since installation we are seeing good power generated right from sunrise which is helpful when one of our peak tariff times is from 7am-9am. Overall would recommend Huglo for a solar instal as they are very helpful and professional

I sought three quotes through Solar Quotes in late July 2023 for a home solar system. Of the three quotes, one didn’t address my requirements so was discarded straight away. The other two, Huglo Solar and another local Canberra company, replied with very similar quotes for a 13.2kW system with a 10kW inverter.I chose Huglo Solar because they were more open to discussing options to make maximum use of my complicated roof. Their staff were also very helpful throughout the sales process. Luke took the time to explain things and listened to my questions and requirements and made changes to the design of the system to meet my needs. We ended up with an 18.48kW system (42 solar panels) with a SolarEdge 15 kW three phase inverter. Our panel arrays face east, north and west, and generate electricity from just after sunrise until late afternoon when the shade covers our roof. Hopefully, this will 'future proof' our system for when we consider adding a hot water heat pump, home battery and EV charger in a few years.The installation went very smoothly. The team arrived on time, were polite and cleaned up after themselves. They were back the day after our installation to fix a faulty connection they had detected remotely, and to walk me through our new solar system. As part of the installation Huglo Solar arranged the upgrade of our electricity meter, upgrade of our home to three phase electricity and connection to the grid. They also helped to move us onto a great solar plan.Huglo Solar's customer service has been great. They were quick to respond when we experienced a communications problem with our inverter and had it resolved in no time.I would highly recommend Huglo Solar.Our home solar system has been operating since 19 October 2023 and I have been very happy with its performance. Our first electricity bill after the installation, after only 40 days of use, was in credit! Our subsequent electricity bills have also been in credit. Our electricity bill for the winter quarter ending 27 August 2024, after including the $75 Australian Government Energy Bill Relief and solar feed in tariff, was $185. In comparison, our electricity bill on 29 August 2023 was $683. We replaced our ducted gas heating and electric evaporative cooling system in mid-July 2023 with a ducted electric reverse cycle air conditioning system. Our only remaining gas appliance is our instantaneous hot water system.

The salesperson was nice and patient, and customer service was efficient and polite. The installation makes me feel professional. I am just a bit worried that it may be trespassing on my neighbour's roof.

Super easy and punctual quote - by far the easiest and most personable (actually read our quote request) that we dealt with.Installation was easy and simple, barely noticed they were here. Chatty and helpful.Great to have a hot shower this morning!

Note, this was just a battery/EV charger installation to my existing Solar system.Sales/quoting process was timely and efficient.Installation was conducted in a timely manner. Installers were polite and efficient. Tidy - they even swept out the garage before departure.Arranged grid connections

Huglo Solar recently fitted solar panels, inverter and battery to my home. From the first contact to the final phone call the Team at Huglo were amazing. I was walked through the installation process, provided with quotes for a number of options and felt no pressure through the decision making process (thank you Luke). Once a decision was made Chloe took over and seamlessly managed the project and listened to my requests. All communication with Chloe was clear and well explained. Lee and his team came and installed the system all the while keeping me informed and leaving the place neat and tidy.I could not ask for better professional service and courtesy than I received from Huglo Solar - thank you.

I sought three quotes for Solar Panels, Storage Battery and a Heat Pump.One was a no show, the other was close but Huglo Solar's quotes were the most detailed and informative with a competitive price.I found Huglo Solar staff were readily contactable, easy to discuss matters with and provided clarification for questions I had.Installation was well organised and timely. I had the heat pump installed initially followed a short time later with the Solar Panels and storage Battery.Huglo staff kept me informed at each step of the process.On the day of each of the installations the staff were punctual, communicated their needs eg. when and for how long power had to be cut off to complete the installation.Overall a very polite, skilled and professional team in every respect.The standard of workmanship is a credit to them.Clean up after the installation was first rate.I was shown through all steps on use of the systems the monitoring application and what steps I may need to take in managing the system eg emergency shutdown.I have been given all required documentation for the install and assistance with grid connection.I have received follow-up calls from Huglo staff after the installation to see if I had any concerns or queries regarding the system and its functionality.Credit where credit is due. There are a lot of businesses, along with Banks, Government Agencies and major corporations for that matter; out there today that could learn a lot about customer service from the Huglo Solar team.

I was seeking to add a battery to the our current system.Of the three quotes I received via Solar Quotes, Huglo Solar's quote was the best as they actually listened to what I wanted.The initial quote was provided by Jason at the end of May.  I accepted the quote and paid the deposit on 4 June 2024.The quote was subsequently updated following a site inspection by one of their installers. No additional deposit was required.This involved the installation of a Sungrow SBR128 battery and a Sungrow SH5.0RS-ADA inverter with grid back up and a changeover switch. It also included the installation of a bollard and smoke detector as the battery is in the garage.Aside from the initial install date being changed by Huglo (from 27 June to 11 July), the installation on the day went smoothly (and cleanly) taking only 3.5 hours from arrival to departure.  The system and the iSolar app was explained to me clearly and concisely.  The system is also ready for the addition of solar panels should we choose to go down that route.The paperwork was sent to me the next day including the form to go to my energy provider regarding the additions to my system.Communication was excellent with regard to all aspects of the install - in particular with Jason, Daniel, Lee and Chloe.  I particularly appreciated the phone calls I received with regard to the arrivals for site inspections and the install itself.I would highly recommend Huglo Solar' services.(I did enjoy watching the solar being consumed from the battery until 9:48pm on the first day despite the battery only being up and running from around 12:40pm)
Extremely happy with Huglo Solar ,the team from ACT . From the Sales team to the faultless installation team under the supervision of Stephen Black .

From starting the process of getting quotes to the system being up and running we cannot faut Huglo Solar.Everything was explained well and any questions answered, all without any hard selling.Communication was first class with updates on the installation and what was required sent though promptly.The installation was done on schedule and without any issues.  No mess was left behind and everything that we needed to know about the system was explained in an easy to understand manner.Thanks to Tim, Mitch, Chloe and the rest of team for making what is a big investment so easy.

Tim, from Huglo Solar took the time to explain my options right from the start. He gave me several quotes depending on different variables, but initially I didn’t choose him because he wasn’t the cheapest. I returned to Tim because he’d taken the time first time around - and what a good decision that was. Our roof had tricky access and a steep pitch. Tim worked through all the problems and we had our solar system. The installers were fantastic and worked on to get it all finished without having to return a second day. I can’t rate Tim and his team highly enough. Knowledgeable, professional, enthusiastic, consistent and fair. A great experience.

Quote was prompt & Luke was fabulous to deal with & a fountain of knowledge. I requested a site visit which he undertook without issue.  Installation was seamless.  Arrived on time, tidy - the team were a delight to have here.  Explained everything on completion in a manner I could understand
Excellent service, good communication and easy installation process.we are very happy

Daniel and Huglo team has been phenomenal with their service from quoting, answering queries and install. Very easy to communicate with and will always check and ensure that we are receiving excellent service. Quoted several months before the actual install due to wait time on Strata approval but Huglo team has been patient and answered all queries prior to install.They were able to schedule the install a week after we have received approval from Strata to proceed.The boys attended site on schedule and completed works by afternoon. System has been working fine and happy harvesting free energy now.
Recommend to anyone who is looking for solar energy gereat service easy to deal with

From the first time we were put in contact with Huglo, they were generous with their time in answering all the questions of a newbie to solar. Their answers were informative and in a language we understood. They did not try to sell a system larger than we needed and didn't want to see us overspending on unnecessary extras such as a battery based on our usage at the moment.Between us, we did some extra research to determine what would save us the most money with hot water usage and Huglo came along on that journey with us, still ensuring we didn't overspend on something we would not benefit from.We ended up with a system that was of a size that will definitely save money, and a Green CATCH Power that saves us even more with our hot water system (both in time and money). Our first bill since installation has put us in credit already, so we couldn't ask for more than that.The entire team kept their promises in returning calls, staying in contact, installation and follow-up. Totally impressed by their customer service and workmanship - the team has done a greyt job. Would definitely recommend them.

We recently had a solar system installed and I couldn't be happier with the entire experience. From start to finish, the process was incredibly smooth and efficient. The installation was completed quickly and precisely and ahead of schedule.There were no unexpected costs or hidden fees. The cost transparency and competitive pricing were truly impressive with an emphasis on 'value for money' rather than 'biggest and fanciest'.Customer support was exceptional throughout. Every question was answered promptly and thoroughly, and the team was always friendly and professional. They went above and beyond to ensure that we were fully satisfied with the installation.Overall, we highly recommend this company for their outstanding service, efficiency, and excellent customer care!

The team at Huglo Solar took the time to answer all my questions and run through the whole process with me. From the initial sales call to the end of the installation, they have been honest and helpful.They were happy to re-do and amend quotes for us as well as noticing meter box changes that needed to happen. There were no surprises, and everything was communicated clearly.They handled everything from the meter box rebuild to solar installation.I would without a doubt recommend their service to anyone!

From start to finish, Luke and Danny demonstrated an impressive level of patience and responsiveness. The world of solar panels, inverters, and batteries is very new to me and my partner (was definitely overwhelmed at times!). Every question we had was answered timely and thoroughly over the phone or via email. We were initially unsure about whether to include a battery in our solar setup. However, after multiple discussions and some gentle guidance, we decided to get one. And we're very happy with our setup –  it's been a week since installation and we haven't used any energy from the grid once despite the relatively lousy weather.On installation day, Lee and team were punctual and efficient. The entire process went smoothly, and the team ensured everything was installed correctly and neatly.Overall, our experience with Huglo was outstanding. Their patience, responsiveness, and professionalism exceeded our expectations. We highly recommend them.

I got four quotes from different providers. All four quoted a very similar system. Huglo was the most competitively priced.Install was booked in 4-6 weeks after deposit and install was very smooth. Installers were polite and respectful and left the place pretty tidy.Over all a happy result.

We engaged Huglo to install our solar system towards the beginning of 2023, and were so happy with the job they did we got them to come back later to retrofit a battery and install a heat pump hot water system. These guys really know their stuff and were happy to spend the time talking us through our various options and what would work best for us. I would have no hesitation in recommending them to anyone after a good quality solar install!

Had a wonderful experience with Huglo Solar and cannot recommend them highly enough. From the first call, I had solar installed at my place within 3 weeks. After comparing and talking to few other companies I felt very confident going ahead with Huglo. The customer service is remarkable and solar solution provided is top class.Luke is very knowledgeable and great to deal with.  He answered all my queries, provided various options and desgined a custom solution for my home. Daniel and Chloe were amazing and extremely thorough with their communications about every step, before and after the installation and organised the grid connection for me.Install went very smooth and tidy- Mitch and the boys did a fantastic job and explained everything in detail. Massive thank you to Luke, Dan, Chloe, Mitch and the team.

The sales quoting process was excellent, we appreciated that Huglo were the only company to actually come to our house and sit down and discuss with us our aim and what they can offer. The two other companies we obtained quotes from would only give us a quote over the phone. Jason from Huglo was great to talk to, friendly and knew his stuff and was prepared to look at different options for us as we were adding to our existing solar panels.Installion was a breeze! They showed up on time when they said they would, the team where lovely, polite people and very efficient and left no mess.Huglo set everything up, gave us a link to the monitoring site and we didn't have to do anything but watch our solar panels sending energy back to our energy provider.We are very happy with Huglo's service and our new panels! :)

Everyone I dealt with at Huglo was friendly, polite and professional. We discussed various options during the sales/quoting process and finalised the positioning of the panels on their site visit. On installation day the teams arrived promptly and the whole job was complete and tidy in a few hours. We couldn't have asked for better. The grid connection went smoothly and we are now enjoying the benefits of an excellent solar system.
Fantastic price and communication from Installer from start to finish. Installationwas completed  ahead of schedule and all paperwork required for connection was carried out by Installer.

The quoting process was professional and most helpful. The installation went very smoothly, the team were very efficient and cleaned the worksite when finished, they were punctual and polite. Following the installation, customer service was exemplary with follow up and completing the paperwork.

Quoting was stressful as they and others could not tell which unit it was from the air.Installation was excellent, but I was left with the hot water turned off, discovered on Fri evening of a long weekend!I was sent an email on how to get the grid connection done.Checked yesterday and all is well.

Solar Quotes was a great one stop shop for information and quality Solar system suppliers.  Using the system quickly led us to three quality suppliers: one of which was Huglo Solar in Canberra.  Of the three suppliers, Huglo offered a great personal service and a good value for money proposal.  Staff were courteous, prompt and always provided informative responses to our many questions.  While there was  some problems sourcing panels from their overseas suppliers, staff kept us up to date and bore the cost of sudden unit price increase above what had been quoted.  Once the panels were available, Huglo quickly arranged for an installation date and turned up to do the job notwithstanding some wet weather conditions.  Installation was completed in a half a day and the system was up and running.  The installation crew were very professional.  The lead installer walked us through the system and we are off and running.

An excellent installation from start to finish. Tim and his team were prompt with their responses to initial requests, highly knowledgeable and focused on customer service throughout the process. This included fast turnaround for quotes (and modifications), specific inquiries and site visits, and tailored recommendations for the specific system and our circumstances. Huglo were fast and professional with the installation - including accelerating the installation when a window opened early, flexible repayment and a wide range of ongoing support. We are very happy with the installed system and recommend Huglo to anyone considering solar power.

Sales process was very prompt and responsive to my requests -as was the installation.Tim was always ready to answer all the questions and provide assistance.Would highly recommend them for your design install.

The sales/quoting process was smooth and efficient.The installation went exceptionally well - polite, tidy, and punctual.Customer service was excellent; they assisted with organizing the grid connection after the install.Overall, I'm very happy with the experience

Dan, Luke and the team at Huglo Solar provided an outstanding service and provided excellent advice and guidance from initial contact to final installation. Their final price was great and the system was installed on the date promised without any issues. Thanks very much Huglo Solar - highly recommended for your solar system needs!

Do yourself a favour and talk to Huglo about your solar. That was the advice we received from family and friends, and we certainly have no regrets since doing so.We’re really impressed with the Huglo team. In our experiences Huglo communicated often and were professional in all our dealings. They provided sound advice about system sizing and design options; the team that completed the install did an awesome job considering the unstable weather conditions on the day; and the day after install, a team member contacted us to make sure we were happy with the work that had been completed, and ensure we had a good understanding of our new system and future servicing requirements.We’re really pleased to able to recommend the services of Huglo Solar.

Onsite inspection was very informative.  The proposed system made maximum use of all available area on a convoluted roof.  Installation was very well executed with good explanation of the various switches.  The system is working well and gives the predicted output.

Sales and quoting went well. Plenty of time to discuss options.   Big job removing old panels and installing new system. Installers were punctual, polite and worked late to get system up and running.  Had to pay extra for steep roof pitch.

Luke McInnes from Huglo Solar was lovely and very helpful.  The installation was a breeze (for me at least).  I don't know if it was for the guys doing the job!!!Not that noisy, the guys were polite and informative.I would thoroughly recommend this firm and their workers.They connected me to my new smart meter and all things are working fine.Thank you for recommending this firm.They also glued up a few cracked tiles they came across....my roof is 35 years old.  No leaks now.

After about 6 months back and forth with Huglo, changing system specs, array splits etc we finally went ahead with a 11.44kw system with Jinko panels, Sungrow 3-phase inverter and Tigo optimisers on all panels.They were incredibly patient with all my questions and explained everything to me in a way I could understand withouth making me feel like an idiot. Their communication throughout the process was impeccable.The team that carried out the install were professional and polite and can't be faulted, they left no mess at all.After the system was online, Huglo put us in contact with a provider, and great information to put us onto a plan with unbelievable rates for supply, consumption and feed-in.I cannot speak more highly of the team at Huglo, I encourage anyone in the ACT looking to put in solar and/or a battery to reach out to them.
FantasticImpressed with the electrician and installers provided the acrylic tile is replaced and we sought out the cooktop issueYes yet to happen though. Booked for this Friday

Huglo Solar team have been wonderful and helpful from start to finish. They provided excellent advice and suggestions and were able to provide me the best price for the size of system, quality of panels and inverter I was seeking. They provided me a single contact point for the project and always kept me advised of the next steps. At no point in the process was I kept in the dark or not informed about potential issues or changes that needed to be made. The terms and conditions of sale and installation were extremely fair and reasonable, providing protections for both myself and Huglo. There was no pressure and the quote and sale felt more like a conversation than a push to buy.The install team were great, very quick and efficient installing the entire system in about 5 hours. They kept me informed throughout the installation. The finished install is neat and tidy and the crew made sure everything was working. They cleaned up prior to departure and showed me the key parts of the system and how to operate it.After the installation Huglo helped me with minor inconvenience with the Sungrow inverter app with their follow up courtesy call. I'm very happy with the entire process from getting quotes via Solarquotes in mid Feburary 2023 to an installed and operational system in early April 2023. I can highly recommend Huglo Solar.
Huglo Solar did installation, connectionand everything related to Solar panel in best way as per their promise and guided us end to end

The entire experience with Huglo Solar was excellent. The customer service was open and honest, and the installation was smooth and problem free.They organised everything for us, including finding a suitable roof tile supplier.

A very professional trustworthy company to do  business with. From my original dealings with Tim & Lee who provided a fast very competitive quote after scoping the job, to Mitch and team who installed the top quality products in a fast efficient manner on the set day. Fantastic follow up service to arrange meter install, advice on solar app set up and further questions about my solar setup.I would highly recommend the Huglo team to anyone looking at a solar energy setup. Thanks team. Mark

From sales person to install, all aspects were professional and on time.Answered my question re integrating an old  preexisting solar system.Install was excellent and the Huglo team organised everything.Service was excellent.
